senses.definition: Any bone, such as the mastoid process or those of the birds, that contains many hollow cells full of air
Any device which generates or is powered by compressed air.
A heavy drill consisting of a bit powered by compressed air, used e.g. for breaking tarmac.
A postal service delivering messages through pneumatic tubes.

senses.definition: A piece of laboratory apparatus, consisting of a vessel filled with liquid (generally water or mercury), used for collecting gases.
senses.example: The pneumatic trough used at Calne was larger than that he had used in Leeds, and fresh water was not so conveniently at hand.

senses.definition: A form of pneumonia caused by the yeast-like fungus Pneumocystis jirovecii.
Any device designed for use with or relating to the lungs, such as the iron lung and medical ventilator, or any device used in the field of respiratory therapy.
A severe lung infection caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis.
A barangay of San Carlos, Pangasinan, Philippines.
